name: ai-business-designer-skills
description: AI Business Designer skills pack: strategic thinking, opportunity recognition, business case, AI strategy, and change management.

plugins.name: strategic-thinking
plugins.description: Systemic, hypothesis-driven strategic thinking (Liedtka 1998; McKinsey MECE / issue trees).

plugins.name: opportunity-recognition
plugins.description: Systematic identification and assessment of business opportunities (Kirzner, Shane & Venkataraman); also includes the owner's validated Opportunity Value Assessment methodology and the Capability Pattern Mapping abstraction method for identifying analogies.

plugins.name: business-case-and-analysis
plugins.description: Building decision-ready business cases and analyses (BABOK, PMI).

plugins.name: ai-strategy-and-governance
plugins.description: Identifying AI opportunities from the task level (SML/Dual Decomposition) or via diagnostic questions from 13 curated AI capability patterns (cross-checked against two independent industry AI use-case reports), through to 5-dimensional scoring and 2x2 prioritization, identifying transformative Value Play opportunities, AI-native business models, roadmaps (3 horizons), and responsible adoption — including productizing discovery engagements.

plugins.name: change-and-communication
plugins.description: Change management, facilitation, and executive communication amid uncertainty.

plugins.name: business-design-frameworks
plugins.description: A growing collection of ways to structure and model business, value creation, and positioning (layer models, value chains, category modeling, strategy canvases/value curves, and more to come).

plugins.name: prototyping-and-demonstration
plugins.description: Fast, credible prototyping (including AI-assisted "vibe coding"), correctly framing a demo/PoC/pilot to manage customer expectations, demo delivery craft (Great Demo! methodology) and storytelling (Amazon Working Backwards/PR-FAQ), and the bridge from demo/PoC to a business case and ROI calculation.

plugins.name: data-strategy-and-literacy
plugins.description: Diagnosing the role of data (enabler vs. strategic asset), a four-quadrant data literacy assessment, critical reading of data (bias, quality, representativeness), data storytelling for business audiences, Data & AI strategy design (Driver Tree, Agile Value Assessment), and selecting a data monetization model (direct vs. indirect, Data Flywheel).

plugins.name: human-ai-collaboration-design
plugins.description: Designing intentional, accountable human-AI partnership: a four-level HITL maturity model with confidence-score routing, behavioral/tone specification for AI outputs, accuracy guardrails and grounding against sycophancy, override-rate auditing and the AI Flywheel, and protecting expert agency and apprenticeship pathways from AI erosion.

plugins.name: specialisation-ai-native-startup-design
plugins.description: How to design an AI-native product/business from the ground up: AI opportunity identification, ICP/JTBD customer understanding, 5+2 need-theme scoring and AI wedge selection, solution ideation, RICE-based MVP selection, a PRD for a build agent, conversational OS architecture, closed-loop process design, and AI tool-stack selection. Anchored in the owner's AI-native Business Design workshop and an external AI-first SaaS Product methodology.

plugins.name: specialisation-business-model-canvas
plugins.description: BMC consulting expertise: a public 159-pattern innovation library, the owner's own variation/clarity logic and antipattern detection, plus research-based support for session facilitation, canvas diagnostics, tool selection, and client-language interpretation.

plugins.name: specialisation-public-sector-ai-service-design
plugins.description: A public-sector lens on top of the core AI-strategy, business-case, and stakeholder-mapping skills: screening AI ideas for public value and mandate fit, mapping the distinct stakeholder types and veto points in public organizations, navigating procurement and public funding, regulatory and equity guardrails for citizen-facing AI, and a six-element decision-readiness model for presenting an AI proposal to a public decision body.

plugins.name: specialisation-research-commercialisation
plugins.description: Research commercialisation: from opportunity recognition to the spin-out/licensing choice, IP, TTO collaboration, funding, and team building. Anchored in the owner's published commercialisation guide and the AFCA self-assessment.
